acq_time.Description: Acquisition time of the particular scan

reprostim_path.Description: Path to the source .mkv file the injected recording was sliced from, relative to the videos.tsv location

reprostim_offset.Description: Offset of the buffer-segment start into the source video

reprostim_buffer_before.Description: Actual buffer prepended before scan onset

reprostim_buffer_after.Description: Actual buffer appended after scan end
